001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity;
002
003import android.net.Uri;
004import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
005import androidx.room.ColumnInfo;
006import androidx.room.Embedded;
007import androidx.room.Entity;
008import androidx.room.ForeignKey;
009import androidx.room.Index;
010import androidx.room.PrimaryKey;
011import com.google.gson.annotations.Expose;
012import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.pojo.Location;
013import java.time.Instant;
014import java.util.UUID;
015
016@Entity(
017    tableName = "pin",
018    indices = {
019        @Index(value = {"title"}, unique = true)
020    },
021    foreignKeys = {
022        @ForeignKey(entity = User.class, parentColumns = "user_id", childColumns = "user_id", onDelete = ForeignKey.CASCADE),
023        @ForeignKey(entity = Track.class, parentColumns = "track_id", childColumns = "track_id", onDelete = ForeignKey.SET_NULL)
024    }
025)
026public class Pin {
027
028  @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true)
029  @ColumnInfo(name = "pin_id")
030  private long id;
031
032  @NonNull
033  @ColumnInfo(collate = ColumnInfo.NOCASE)
034  @Expose
035  private String title = "";
036
037  @ColumnInfo(name = "track_id", index = true)
038  private Long trackId;
039
040  @ColumnInfo(name = "user_id", index = true)
041  private long userId;
042
043
044  @NonNull
045  @Expose
046  private String content = "";
047
048  private Uri image;
049
050  @NonNull
051  @ColumnInfo(name = "created_on", index = true)
052  private Instant createdOn = Instant.now();
053
054  @NonNull
055  @ColumnInfo(name = "modified_on", index = true)
056  private Instant modifiedOn = Instant.now();
057
058  @Embedded
059  private Location location;
060
061  public long getId() {
062    return id;
063  }
064
065  public void setId(long id) {
066    this.id = id;
067  }
068
069  @NonNull
070  public String getTitle() {
071    return title;
072  }
073
074  public void setTitle(@NonNull String title) {
075    this.title = title;
076  }
077
078  @NonNull
079  public String getContent() {
080    return content;
081  }
082
083  public void setContent(@NonNull String content) {
084    this.content = content;
085  }
086
087  public Uri getImage() {
088    return image;
089  }
090
091  public void setImage(Uri image) {
092    this.image = image;
093  }
094
095  @NonNull
096  public Instant getCreatedOn() {
097    return createdOn;
098  }
099
100  public void setCreatedOn(@NonNull Instant createdOn) {
101    this.createdOn = createdOn;
102  }
103
104  @NonNull
105  public Instant getModifiedOn() {
106    return modifiedOn;
107  }
108
109  public void setModifiedOn(@NonNull Instant modifiedOn) {
110    this.modifiedOn = modifiedOn;
111  }
112
113
114   public Location getLocation() {
115    return location;
116  }
117
118  public void setLocation(Location location) {
119    this.location = location;
120  }
121
122  public Long getTrackId() {
123    return trackId;
124  }
125
126  public void setTrackId(Long trackId) {
127    this.trackId = trackId;
128  }
129
130  public long getUserId() {
131    return userId;
132  }
133
134  public void setUserId(long userId) {
135    this.userId = userId;
136  }
137
138}
